name: outrider-agent-clis
description: Pinned versions of the coding-agent CLIs the action installs globally on the runner, and the Node line the runner uses (engines.node). Not an installable package: action.yml reads these and runs `npm install -g <pkg>@<version>` on that Node. Exact pins on purpose (#128); Dependabot bumps the CLIs, the install step refuses a CLI whose engine floor the Node line does not satisfy, and tests/test_action_install_surface.py refuses ranges.
